# 🐞 Bug Report

> **Complete all sections below to help the engineering team identify and resolve the bug promptly. Reports with missing information will be rejected or require additional details.**

---

## 1. General Information

- **Bug title (Required):**  
  _(Clear, concise, and accurately describes the bug)_

- **Severity (Required):**
  - [ ] Blocker (Service outage, major data loss)
  - [ ] Critical (Affects primary functionality)
  - [ ] Major (Affects secondary functionality)
  - [ ] Minor (Minor issue with a workaround)
  - [ ] Trivial (UI or spelling issue)

- **Resolution priority (Required):**
  - [ ] P1 (Immediate action)
  - [ ] P2 (Important)
  - [ ] P3 (Normal)
  - [ ] P4 (Low)

- **Related module/functionality:**  
  _(E.g.: API, UI, DB, Auth, ...)_  

---

## 2. Affected Environment

- **Operating system (Required):**  
  _(Windows, Linux, macOS, Android, iOS, ... + version)_

- **Browser/App version (Required):**  
  _(Chrome/Firefox/Safari/Edge, App build, commit SHA, ... )_

- **Environment:**  
  - [ ] Development
  - [ ] Staging
  - [ ] Production
  - [ ] Other: ___________________

- **Affected account/user:**  
  _(username, access permissions, ... if applicable)_

---

## 3. Bug Description

- **Brief description (Required):**  
  _(Observed issue, incorrect behavior)_

- **Expected result (Required):**  
  _(How should the system behave?)_

- **Actual result (Required):**  
  _(How does the system currently behave?)_

---

## 4. Steps to Reproduce

1. Step 1:
2. Step 2:
3. ...
   
- **Frequency:**
  - [ ] 100% (Always occurs)
  - [ ] Intermittent (specify the rate)

---

## 5. Illustrations & Evidence

- **Screenshot (Required):**  
  _(Attach an image or paste a link)_

- **Reproduction video (if available):**  
  _(Attach or provide a link)_

- **Affected URL:**  
  _(link/URL where the bug occurs)_

- **Log/Error trace:**  
  _(Paste error logs or stack traces with sensitive information redacted)_

---

## 6. Additional Technical Information

- **Affected commit/release:**  
  _(SHA/git tag/branch, release notes, related PR)_

- **Special configuration/settings:**  
  _(Feature flag, config, ... if applicable)_

- **Related third-party service/API:**  
  _(Service name, status, response code, ...)_

---

## 7. Reporter

- **Full name/Username:**  
- **Email/Slack:**  
- **Team/Department:**  

---

## 8. Checklist

- [ ] Completed the report template
- [ ] Checked that the bug is not a duplicate
- [ ] Added logs/screenshots/video
- [ ] Retested in another environment (if available)
- [ ] Notified stakeholders (for a severe bug)

---

> **Note:** The more detailed the report, the easier it is to resolve the bug thoroughly. Bug reports will be ignored unless all information labeled `(Required)` is provided.
